content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: A Graduate preferably a Post Graduate in Commerce/Business Administration/Humanities. Experience required: Should have about 10-15 years experience in Finance and Administration in Central Government. Age limit: Preferably around 40-45 years of age but not above 56 years of age. Pay: Level 14 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Qualification required: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institution/ University. Experience required: Should have about 10-15 years of experience in the field in Central/ State Government/ PSU/ Autonomous Bodies specially in project appraisal. Age limit: Maximum 58 years. Pay: Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Qualification required: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognised Institution/University. Experience required: The officer should have a minimum of 5 years experience in Civil Engineering Works related to the Field of activity in road construction. Age limit: Preferably in the age group of 30-45 years but not exceeding 56 years. Pay: Pay Level 13A of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Qualification required: A degree in Civil Engineering preferably a Post Graduate or equivalent degree. Experience required: The officer should have a minimum of 5 years experience in Civil Engineering works related to the field of activity in road construction. Age limit: Around 30-45 years but not above 56 years. Pay: Level 12 of 7th CPC pay Matrix. Qualification required: Must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University. Experience required: The candidate should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the areas of Government/Commercial/Public Works Accounting. Age limit: Preferably around 30-45 years but in any case not above 56 years of age. Pay: Pay Matrix 11 as per 7th CPC.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial engagement on contract basis will be for one year, extendable further if work is found satisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NRIDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NRIDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 1 Director (Finance & Administration), 1 Director (Project/Technical), 4 Joint Director (Project/Technical), 2 Deputy Director (Project/Technical), 1 Assistant Director (Finance & Administration).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NRIDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (https://nrida.dord.gov.in) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Director (Finance & Administration): preferably around 40-45 years of age but not above 56 years of age; Director (Project/Technical): maximum 58 years; Joint Director (Project/Technical): preferably in the age group of 30-45 years but not exceeding 56 years; Deputy Director (Project/Technical): around 30-45 years but not above 56 years; Assistant Director (Finance & Administration): preferably around 30-45 years but in any case not above 56 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 14 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC for Director (Finance & Administration), Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix for Director (Project/Technical), Pay Level 13A of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC for Joint Director (Project/Technical), Level 12 of 7th CPC pay Matrix for Deputy Director (Project/Technical), Pay Matrix 11 as per 7th CPC for Assistant Director (Finance & Administration).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate/Post Graduate in relevant discipline. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Deputation / contract selection process.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial engagement on contract basis will be for one year, extendable further if work is found satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cadre clearance; Vigilance clearance; Certified copies of APARs of last five years.
